status.main_product: Drone surveying services, drone hardware, and aerial data analytics software
status.scope_reason: The company provides end-to-end commercial drone solutions, including integrated aerial surveying, topographic mapping, and proprietary spatial data processing software under its own brand name.
status.evidence: According to a Tracxn company profile updated in 2026, Aereo (formerly Aarav Unmanned Systems) operates as an active provider of drone survey services and integrated aerial data analytics based in Bengaluru, India.

claims.claim: The company reports its proprietary Aereo-INP (an indigenous, autonomous, single-man portable drone) and Aereo-ZFR (a hybrid drone platform featuring multi-sensor integration and an advanced composite structure) tailored for large-scale enterprise mapping.

The company reports it has successfully integrated LiDAR and SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) technology into its drone platforms to construct precise 3D tunnel maps and navigate underground mining spaces lacking a GPS signal.
claims.note: The integration of LiDAR and SLAM technology specifically into Aereo's drone platforms to navigate underground mining spaces and construct 3D tunnel maps is unverified.
claims.source: Aereo Corporate Site and Executive Updates (https://aereo.io/)

claims.claim: The company reports that its cloud-based platform, Aereo Cloud, converts raw drone data into native geospatial outputs, including 3D point clouds, elevation models, and 2D/3D maps.

Technical profiles indicate that Aereo's hardware architecture utilizes built-in Post-Processed Kinematic (PPK) geotagging engines and passive damping infrastructure, which eliminate the need for Ground Control Points (GCPs) while achieving absolute survey accuracies of 2 cm horizontally and 3.5 cm vertically.
claims.source: TechSagar Aarav Unmanned Systems Hardware Profile (https://www.techsagar.in/robotics-and-autonomous-systems/company/aarav-unmanned-systems)

claims.claim: In a March 2026 validation project, Aereo was contracted by Coal India Limited to validate the accuracy of drone surveys against the client's terrestrial laser scanner reference standards across approximately 50 sites, resulting in updates to Coal India's official "Yellow Book" rulebook to permit standard operating procedures using survey-grade PPK drones and DGPS base stations.
claims.corrected: In a February 2023 validation project, Aereo was contracted by Coal India Limited to validate the accuracy of drone surveys against the client's terrestrial laser scanner reference standards across approximately 50 sites, resulting in updates to Coal India's official "Yellow Book" rulebook to permit standard operating procedures using survey-grade PPK drones and DGPS base stations.
claims.source: Coal India Limited Project Reports & Press Releases via Bots & Drones / LinkedIn Executive Posts (https://botsanddrones.in/agriculture-drones/f/aereo-wins-contract-to-digitize-7-major-mines-of-coal-india)

claims.claim: The company reports that its indigenously developed and fully autonomous drone solutions deliver a flight time of 33 minutes and can map an area of 100 hectares in a single flight.
The company reports utilizing LiDAR, point cloud, image, and video data for detection, segmentation, and reconstruction tasks within its integrated mining monitoring and asset management workflows.

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: The company reports holding 15 patents over its drone designs, processing algorithms, data analytics, and monetization techniques, and it became the first company to receive a Small Category certification from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) in India.

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: Aereo's R&D team has authored 4 patent filings specifically focused on multimodal perception and terrain intelligence to automate large-scale geospatial analytics platforms like the National Land Intelligence Platform.

Aereo won a USD 1 million, 3-year open-tender contract from Coal India Limited (CIL) to provide survey-grade PPK drones and advanced web-platform analytics to digitise 7 major open-cast mines across Northern Coalfields Limited and South Eastern Coalfields.

The company reports securing a long-term engagement with Tata Steel to jointly develop and offer end-to-end drone solutions for open-cast mining operations, and it has served as an execution partner for the government's SVAMITVA scheme, mapping more than 40,000 villages.
claims.corrected: The company reports being empanelled with Tata Steel since 2019 to aid the digitalisation of over 27 critical mines and stockyards, and it has served as an execution partner for the government's SVAMITVA scheme, mapping more than 40,000 villages.

claims.claim: The company reported annual revenue of ₹59.7 crore for FY24, representing an increase of 13.6% from ₹52.6 crore in FY23, alongside a reported net loss of ₹12.5 crore in FY24.
The company reported a 400% revenue growth over the two years leading up to July 2024, driven by its sector-specific commercial solutions.
The company reports mapping over 45,000 villages under the SVAMITVA scheme, more than five million acres of land total, and the entire state of Haryana (28,000 square kilometers) within 14 months.

The company reports deployment capabilities enabling a 10-district project in Karnataka encompassing 86,000 square kilometers, utilizing 60 survey-grade post-processed kinematic (PPK) drones to map approximately 1.75 lakh acres daily on average.
claims.corrected: The company reports deployment capabilities enabling a 10-district project in Karnataka encompassing 68,000 square kilometers, utilizing 60 survey-grade post-processed kinematic (PPK) drones to map approximately 1.75 lakh acres daily on average.

claims.claim: Aereo announced a global go-to-market partnership and collaboration agreement with Datamine on October 16, 2025, to deliver a unified, AI-driven ecosystem connecting drone aerial intelligence with mining software workflows.
Aereo announced a strategic alliance with UAE-based Seed Group on March 17, 2025, to expand its commercial drone solutions, AI analytics, and aerial intelligence into the UAE and MENA region.
claims.corrected: Aereo announced a strategic alliance with UAE-based Seed Group on March 18, 2025, to expand its commercial drone solutions, AI analytics, and aerial intelligence into the UAE and MENA region.

claims.claim: Aereo (formerly AUS) reports that it has mapped over 40,000 villages under the central government's SVAMITVA scheme, millions of acres of land, and numerous mine surveys across India.
The company reports that its proprietary digital intelligence platform, Aereo Cloud, has been utilized to map an accumulated area of 150,000 square kilometres.
claims.note: 150,000 square kilometres area mapped specifically by Aereo Cloud platform (rather than company-wide land mapping)

status.main_product: Drone surveying and LiDAR mapping services
status.scope_reason: The company provides drone-based aerial surveys, LiDAR mapping, and geospatial data intelligence services for the mining industry under its own name.
status.evidence: According to Ministry of Corporate Affairs registry data on Tofler, Droid Mining Solutions Private Limited is an active company incorporated in March 2024 that offers specialized drone surveys and LiDAR intelligence.

claims.claim: The company reports integrating a payload suite that features LiDAR (supporting dense 3D point clouds with up to 5 returns per pulse and a pulse rate of 600,000 Hz), thermal, multispectral, RGB, magnetometer, gas sensing, and hyperspectral sensors.

The company showcased its advanced UAV solutions, including LiDAR mapping, underground drone-based stope surveys, magnetic surveys, and heavy-lift drones at the 37th Metalliferous Mines Safety Week 2025 in the Jabalpur Region.

Droid Mining Solutions Private Limited provides post-processing and workflow integration of raw aerial data captured via photogrammetry and LiDAR to deliver outputs such as classified LAS/LAZ point clouds, bare-earth digital terrain models (DTMs), digital surface models (DSMs), 3D mesh models, and contour maps.

The company reports that its processed spatial datasets and deliverables integrate natively into standard engineering and specialized mining applications such as Surpac, AutoCAD, Deswik, Minescape, ArcGIS, and AutoCAD Civil 3D to support compliance reporting for the Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM).
claims.note: Native integration with Minescape, ArcGIS, and AutoCAD Civil 3D for compliance reporting is not confirmed in available documentation. Only Surpac, AutoCAD, and Deswik are specified.

claims.claim: The company reports achieving a 99% mapping accuracy rate and delivering high-resolution spatial models with ground sampling distance (GSD) precision under 1 centimetre.
The company reports utilizing advanced fixed-wing VTOL drone technology, including the Trinity F90+, to capture high-quality aerial data for large-area mapping and mining surveys.
claims.source: Droid Mining Solutions Official Instagram Account Post (September 2024)

claims.claim: An institutional profile published by the Rajiv Gandhi College of Engineering and Research (RCERT) highlights that the startup Droid Mining Solutions deals in drone surveying for large mining and infrastructure companies, specifically noting client names such as Coal India Limited (CIL), ACC, and Indian Railways.
claims.source: Rajiv Gandhi College of Engineering, Research and Technology (RCERT) Official Website

claims.claim: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) records confirm the registration of Droid Mining Solutions as a verified seller (GeM Seller ID: 8NH7210004861202) under the micro and small enterprise (MSE) social category, establishing its formal capability to secure public sector procurement contracts in India.
claims.source: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) Procurement Official Contract Documents

claims.claim: The company generated less than ₹10 Cr in revenue for the financial year ending on March 31, 2025.
claims.source: Tracxn Company Profile / Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) Filing Summary Data

claims.claim: The company's associated entity Droid Survair reports an operational footprint of more than 2.5 lakh acres mapped across India, covering sectors such as agriculture, railways, power, solar, and construction.
claims.source: Droid Survair Official Website and LinkedIn Profile
